description: The stacked bar chart illustrates "SimpleQA performance over the course of post-training." The horizontal axis displays the categorical stages of training, ordered from left to right as "Base," "SFT," "DPO Stage 1," and a fourth category whose label is visually obscured by a solid grey rectangle. The vertical axis, labeled "Percentage (%)," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at regular intervals of 20. Each vertical bar is stacked with three components, identified by a legend at the bottom: "Correct" (green) at the base, "Not Attempted" (dark blue) in the middle, and "Incorrect" (light blue) at the top, with all bars reaching the 100% mark. In the "Base" bar, the "Incorrect" segment is the tallest at 90.0%, "Not Attempted" is 3.2%, and "Correct" is annotated as 6.8% just below the horizontal axis. In the "SFT" bar, annotations include 38.7% in the light blue segment, 57.5% in the middle of the dark blue segment, and 3.7% in white text at the bottom of the dark blue segment. The "DPO Stage 1" bar contains annotations of 17.4% (light blue), 79.8% (dark blue), and 2.9% (bottom of dark blue). The final bar with the obscured label shows 15.8% (the shortest "Incorrect" segment), 81.1% (the tallest "Not Attempted" segment), and 3.0% (bottom of dark blue). Visually, the light blue "Incorrect" segments decrease in height from left to right, while the dark blue "Not Attempted" segments increase, and the green "Correct" segments remain consistently small across all categories.
